description: This file defines a utility function 'mergeMockedModule' for mocking modules in tests. The function takes an actual module and an override builder, merges the original module with override properties possibly asynchronously, and returns the combined module.

methods.name: export async function mergeMockedModule<TModule extends object>( mergeMockedModule
methods.description: Async function that merges a given module with overrides provided by a builder function, supporting partial overrides and asynchronous operations.
